symptoms.name: Crepitus
symptoms.description: Grinding or cracking sound in joints

therapies.name: Physical Therapy
therapies.description: Exercise-based rehabilitation to restore movement, strength, and function through guided physical exercises, stretching, and progressive resistance training

therapies.name: Hydrotherapy
therapies.description: Water-based therapy using buoyancy and resistance for joint mobilization, pain relief, and muscle strengthening in warm water pools
therapies.contraindications: open wounds, urinary infections, severe cardiac disease

therapies.name: Cryotherapy
therapies.description: Cold application therapy to reduce swelling, inflammation, pain, and muscle spasm through ice packs, cold compression, or whole-body cryotherapy
therapies.contraindications: Raynaud disease, cold sensitivity, peripheral vascular disease

therapies.name: Heat Therapy
therapies.description: Application of heat via hot packs, infrared lamps, or paraffin baths to increase blood flow, relax muscles, reduce stiffness, and relieve chronic pain

therapies.name: TENS Therapy
therapies.description: Transcutaneous Electrical Nerve Stimulation using low-voltage electrical currents to block pain signals and stimulate endorphin release

therapies.name: Therapeutic Ultrasound
therapies.description: Deep tissue heating using sound waves to promote tissue healing, reduce scar tissue, increase blood flow, and decrease inflammation
therapies.contraindications: over malignancy, growth plates, eyes, pregnant uterus

therapies.name: Therapeutic Massage
therapies.description: Manual manipulation of soft tissues to reduce muscle tension, improve circulation, decrease pain, and promote lymphatic drainage
therapies.contraindications: DVT, open wounds, skin infections, fractures

therapies.name: Manual Therapy / Mobilization
therapies.description: Hands-on joint mobilization and manipulation to restore range of motion, reduce pain, and improve joint mechanics

therapies.name: Spinal Traction
therapies.description: Mechanical or manual stretching of the spine to decompress nerve roots, reduce disc herniation pressure, and relieve radiculopathy
therapies.contraindications: spinal tumors, osteoporosis, pregnancy, spinal infections

therapies.name: Splinting / Immobilization
therapies.description: External fixation using splints, braces, or casts to protect injured structures, maintain alignment, and allow healing

therapies.name: Compression Therapy
therapies.description: Application of graduated compression stockings or bandages to reduce edema, prevent blood clots, and improve venous return

therapies.name: Elevation Therapy
therapies.description: Elevating the affected limb above heart level to reduce swelling through gravity-assisted venous and lymphatic drainage

therapies.name: Range of Motion Exercises
therapies.description: Active and passive exercises to maintain and restore joint flexibility, prevent contractures, and improve functional mobility

therapies.name: Strengthening Exercises
therapies.description: Progressive resistance training to rebuild muscle strength, improve stability, and support injured joints through isometric, isotonic, and isokinetic protocols

therapies.name: Balance & Proprioception Training
therapies.description: Exercises on unstable surfaces and with perturbation to restore proprioceptive awareness, prevent re-injury, and improve neuromuscular control

therapies.name: Occupational Therapy
therapies.description: Rehabilitation focused on activities of daily living, hand function, adaptive equipment, and workplace ergonomics

therapies.name: Speech & Swallowing Therapy
therapies.description: Therapy for speech, language, cognitive-communication, and swallowing disorders following stroke or neurological injury

therapies.name: Respiratory Therapy
therapies.description: Breathing exercises, chest physiotherapy, incentive spirometry, and airway clearance techniques for pulmonary conditions

therapies.name: Wound Care Management
therapies.description: Systematic wound assessment, debridement, dressing changes, infection control, and promotion of tissue granulation and epithelialization

therapies.name: Thrombolytic Therapy
therapies.description: Administration of clot-dissolving agents to restore blood flow in acute thrombotic events like stroke, pulmonary embolism, and DVT
therapies.contraindications: active bleeding, recent surgery, hemorrhagic stroke

therapies.name: Anticoagulation Therapy
therapies.description: Blood thinning therapy to prevent and treat blood clots through heparin, warfarin, or direct oral anticoagulants

therapies.name: Insulin Therapy
therapies.description: Exogenous insulin administration to manage blood glucose levels in diabetes through subcutaneous injection or insulin pump
therapies.duration: lifelong for Type 1, variable for Type 2

therapies.name: Dialysis Therapy
therapies.description: Renal replacement therapy using hemodialysis or peritoneal dialysis to filter waste products when kidneys fail

therapies.name: Chemotherapy
therapies.description: Systemic administration of cytotoxic drugs to destroy rapidly dividing cancer cells through various protocols and cycles

therapies.name: Radiation Therapy
therapies.description: Targeted high-energy radiation beams to destroy cancer cells and shrink tumors while minimizing damage to surrounding tissue
therapies.contraindications: pregnancy, prior radiation to same area

therapies.name: Cognitive Behavioral Therapy
therapies.description: Psychological therapy for chronic pain management, addressing pain catastrophizing, fear avoidance, and developing coping strategies

therapies.name: Acupuncture
therapies.description: Insertion of fine needles at specific points to modulate pain pathways, reduce inflammation, and promote natural healing

therapies.name: Low-Level Laser Therapy
therapies.description: Application of low-intensity laser light to stimulate cellular repair, reduce inflammation, and accelerate tissue healing

therapies.name: Extracorporeal Shockwave Therapy
therapies.description: High-energy acoustic waves directed at chronic tendinopathy to stimulate neovascularization and tissue remodeling
therapies.contraindications: over nerves, blood vessels, lung tissue, growth plates

therapies.name: Manual Lymphatic Drainage
therapies.description: Gentle massage technique to stimulate lymphatic flow, reduce lymphedema, and decrease post-surgical swelling

medications.name: Ibuprofen
medications.description: Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug for pain, inflammation, swelling, and fever reduction
medications.contraindications: GI ulcers, renal impairment, aspirin allergy

medications.name: Naproxen
medications.description: Long-acting NSAID for inflammation, arthritis pain, musculoskeletal pain, and swelling
medications.contraindications: GI bleeding, renal failure, cardiac disease

medications.name: Diclofenac
medications.description: Potent NSAID available in oral and topical forms for acute musculoskeletal pain, inflammation, and post-surgical swelling

medications.name: Celecoxib
medications.description: COX-2 selective NSAID with reduced GI side effects for osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, and acute pain

medications.name: Paracetamol (Acetaminophen)
medications.description: First-line analgesic and antipyretic for mild to moderate pain and fever reduction

medications.name: Tramadol
medications.description: Centrally acting opioid analgesic for moderate to severe pain with lower abuse potential than strong opioids
medications.contraindications: seizure disorders, MAO inhibitors, respiratory depression

medications.name: Gabapentin
medications.description: Anticonvulsant used for neuropathic pain, nerve damage pain, post-herpetic neuralgia, and diabetic neuropathy

medications.name: Pregabalin
medications.description: Anticonvulsant for neuropathic pain, fibromyalgia, and generalized anxiety with nerve pain component

medications.name: Prednisone
medications.description: Oral corticosteroid for severe inflammation, autoimmune conditions, allergic reactions, and flare management

medications.name: Methylprednisolone
medications.description: Potent corticosteroid for acute inflammatory conditions, spinal cord injury, severe allergic reactions, and joint injections

medications.name: Cortisone Injection
medications.description: Local corticosteroid injection directly into joints or soft tissues for targeted inflammation and pain relief

medications.name: Cyclobenzaprine
medications.description: Skeletal muscle relaxant for acute muscle spasm, strain-related pain, and musculoskeletal spasticity

medications.name: Baclofen
medications.description: GABA-B agonist muscle relaxant for spasticity from spinal cord injury, multiple sclerosis, and cerebral palsy

medications.name: Tizanidine
medications.description: Alpha-2 adrenergic agonist for muscle spasticity and associated pain in multiple sclerosis and spinal cord injury

medications.name: Heparin
medications.description: Rapid-acting anticoagulant for prevention and treatment of deep vein thrombosis, pulmonary embolism, and clot formation
medications.frequency: continuous IV or every 8-12 hours SC

medications.name: Warfarin
medications.description: Oral anticoagulant for long-term prevention of blood clots, stroke prevention in atrial fibrillation, and DVT/PE treatment

medications.name: Rivaroxaban
medications.description: Direct oral anticoagulant (DOAC) Factor Xa inhibitor for DVT/PE treatment and stroke prevention without INR monitoring

medications.name: Aspirin (Low-Dose)
medications.description: Antiplatelet agent for cardiovascular protection, secondary stroke prevention, and peripheral artery disease
medications.contraindications: active GI bleeding, aspirin allergy, children under 16

medications.name: Enoxaparin
medications.description: Low molecular weight heparin for DVT prophylaxis, treatment of acute coronary syndrome, and bridge anticoagulation
medications.contraindications: active bleeding, HIT, severe renal impairment

medications.name: Amoxicillin
medications.description: Broad-spectrum penicillin antibiotic for bacterial infections including skin, respiratory, urinary, and bone infections

medications.name: Cephalexin
medications.description: First-generation cephalosporin for skin infections, cellulitis, bone infections, and UTIs

medications.name: Clindamycin
medications.description: Lincosamide antibiotic for serious skin, bone, and soft tissue infections, especially in penicillin-allergic patients

medications.name: Ciprofloxacin
medications.description: Fluoroquinolone antibiotic for complicated urinary tract, bone, joint, and respiratory infections
medications.contraindications: tendon disorders, myasthenia gravis, QT prolongation

medications.name: Calcium + Vitamin D
medications.description: Calcium and vitamin D supplementation for bone health, osteoporosis prevention, and fracture healing support

medications.name: Alendronate
medications.description: Bisphosphonate for osteoporosis treatment and prevention, reducing fracture risk by inhibiting bone resorption

medications.name: Colchicine
medications.description: Anti-inflammatory agent specifically for acute gout flares and gout prophylaxis by inhibiting neutrophil migration

medications.name: Allopurinol
medications.description: Xanthine oxidase inhibitor to lower uric acid levels for chronic gout management and prevention of urate crystal deposition
medications.contraindications: acute gout flare (initiation), severe renal impairment

medications.name: Metformin
medications.description: First-line oral antidiabetic for type 2 diabetes, improving insulin sensitivity and reducing hepatic glucose output

medications.name: Insulin Glargine
medications.description: Long-acting basal insulin for type 1 and type 2 diabetes providing 24-hour glucose control

medications.name: Atorvastatin
medications.description: HMG-CoA reductase inhibitor (statin) for cholesterol reduction, atherosclerosis management, and cardiovascular risk reduction

medications.name: Amlodipine
medications.description: Calcium channel blocker for hypertension, angina, and coronary artery disease management

medications.name: Lisinopril
medications.description: ACE inhibitor for hypertension, heart failure, and diabetic nephropathy protection
medications.contraindications: pregnancy, angioedema history, bilateral renal artery stenosis

medications.name: Salbutamol (Albuterol)
medications.description: Short-acting beta-2 agonist bronchodilator for acute bronchospasm, asthma, and COPD symptom relief

medications.name: Amoxicillin-Clavulanate
medications.description: Enhanced penicillin with beta-lactamase inhibitor for pneumonia, sinusitis, and complicated skin infections

medications.name: Silver Sulfadiazine
medications.description: Topical antimicrobial cream for burn wound infection prevention and treatment

medications.name: Mupirocin
medications.description: Topical antibiotic for superficial skin infections, impetigo, and wound infection prevention

medications.name: Omeprazole
medications.description: Proton pump inhibitor for peptic ulcers, GERD, and GI protection during NSAID therapy

medications.name: Mesalamine
medications.description: 5-ASA anti-inflammatory for ulcerative colitis and inflammatory bowel disease maintenance

medications.name: Alteplase (tPA)
medications.description: Tissue plasminogen activator for emergency dissolution of blood clots in acute ischemic stroke and pulmonary embolism
medications.contraindications: active bleeding, recent surgery, hemorrhagic stroke

medications.name: Methotrexate
medications.description: Disease-modifying antirheumatic drug (DMARD) for rheumatoid arthritis, psoriatic arthritis, and autoimmune conditions
medications.contraindications: pregnancy, liver disease, immunodeficiency, renal impairment

medications.name: Hydroxychloroquine
medications.description: DMARD for rheumatoid arthritis and systemic lupus with anti-inflammatory and immunomodulatory effects

medications.name: Furosemide
medications.description: Loop diuretic for edema reduction in heart failure, renal disease, and hepatic cirrhosis

diseases.name: Bone Fracture
diseases.description: Complete or partial break in bone continuity due to trauma, stress, or pathological weakening

diseases.name: ACL Tear
diseases.description: Anterior cruciate ligament tear in the knee causing instability and functional impairment

diseases.name: Meniscus Tear
diseases.description: Tear in the knee meniscal cartilage causing pain, locking, and swelling

diseases.name: Rotator Cuff Tear
diseases.description: Tear in one or more rotator cuff tendons causing shoulder pain and weakness

diseases.name: Spinal Disc Herniation
diseases.description: Rupture or protrusion of intervertebral disc material compressing spinal nerves causing radiculopathy

diseases.name: Osteoarthritis
diseases.description: Degenerative joint disease with cartilage loss, osteophyte formation, and progressive joint dysfunction

diseases.name: Rheumatoid Arthritis
diseases.description: Autoimmune inflammatory arthritis causing symmetric joint inflammation, erosion, and systemic effects

diseases.name: Tendinitis
diseases.description: Inflammation or irritation of a tendon causing pain and tenderness near joints

diseases.name: Bursitis
diseases.description: Inflammation of bursae (fluid-filled sacs) near joints causing pain and restricted movement

diseases.name: Muscle Strain
diseases.description: Stretching or tearing of muscle fibers due to overuse, fatigue, or acute trauma

diseases.name: Spinal Stenosis
diseases.description: Narrowing of spinal canal compressing the spinal cord and nerve roots causing pain and neurological symptoms

diseases.name: Osteoporosis
diseases.description: Systemic skeletal disease with reduced bone mineral density increasing fracture risk

diseases.name: Plantar Fasciitis
diseases.description: Inflammation of the plantar fascia causing heel pain, especially with first steps in the morning

diseases.name: Deep Vein Thrombosis
diseases.description: Blood clot formation in deep veins, typically in the legs, causing swelling, pain, and risk of pulmonary embolism

diseases.name: Pulmonary Embolism
diseases.description: Blood clot lodged in pulmonary arteries blocking blood flow to lungs causing chest pain and dyspnea

diseases.name: Ischemic Stroke
diseases.description: Acute cerebrovascular event due to blood clot blocking brain blood supply causing neurological deficits

diseases.name: Atherosclerosis
diseases.description: Plaque buildup in arterial walls causing narrowing, reduced blood flow, and risk of thrombotic events

diseases.name: Peripheral Artery Disease
diseases.description: Atherosclerotic narrowing of peripheral arteries, usually in legs, causing claudication and tissue ischemia

diseases.name: Hypertension
diseases.description: Chronically elevated blood pressure increasing risk of stroke, heart failure, and kidney disease

diseases.name: Peripheral Neuropathy
diseases.description: Damage to peripheral nerves causing numbness, tingling, weakness, and burning pain in extremities

diseases.name: Carpal Tunnel Syndrome
diseases.description: Compression of the median nerve at the wrist causing numbness, tingling, and weakness in the hand

diseases.name: Sciatica
diseases.description: Radicular pain along the sciatic nerve path from lower back through hip and down the leg

diseases.name: Concussion / TBI
diseases.description: Traumatic brain injury causing temporary cognitive, physical, and emotional symptoms

diseases.name: Multiple Sclerosis
diseases.description: Autoimmune demyelinating disease of the central nervous system causing varied neurological symptoms

diseases.name: Burn Injury
diseases.description: Thermal, chemical, or radiation injury to skin causing tissue damage from superficial to full-thickness

diseases.name: Diabetic Foot Ulcer
diseases.description: Chronic non-healing wound on the foot caused by diabetic neuropathy and vascular insufficiency

diseases.name: Pressure Ulcer
diseases.description: Tissue damage from sustained pressure on bony prominences causing skin breakdown and necrosis

diseases.name: Cellulitis
diseases.description: Bacterial skin infection causing redness, swelling, warmth, and pain in affected area

diseases.name: Abscess
diseases.description: Localized collection of pus caused by bacterial infection requiring drainage and antibiotics

diseases.name: Gout
diseases.description: Inflammatory arthritis caused by uric acid crystal deposition in joints causing acute severe pain and swelling

diseases.name: Lymphedema
diseases.description: Chronic swelling due to lymphatic system obstruction or damage causing fluid accumulation in tissues

diseases.name: Ankylosing Spondylitis
diseases.description: Chronic inflammatory disease primarily affecting the spine causing pain, stiffness, and potential spinal fusion

diseases.name: Pneumonia
diseases.description: Infection of lung parenchyma causing consolidation, cough, fever, and respiratory distress

diseases.name: COPD
diseases.description: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease with irreversible airflow limitation causing dyspnea and chronic cough

diseases.name: Pleural Effusion
diseases.description: Accumulation of fluid in the pleural space causing chest pain and shortness of breath

diseases.name: Peptic Ulcer Disease
diseases.description: Erosion of the stomach or duodenal lining causing epigastric pain, bleeding, and perforation risk

diseases.name: Inflammatory Bowel Disease
diseases.description: Chronic inflammation of the gastrointestinal tract including Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis

diseases.name: Liver Cirrhosis
diseases.description: End-stage liver fibrosis causing portal hypertension, ascites, and hepatic dysfunction

diseases.name: Type 2 Diabetes
diseases.description: Metabolic disorder with insulin resistance and progressive beta-cell failure causing hyperglycemia

diseases.name: Diabetic Neuropathy
diseases.description: Nerve damage caused by chronic hyperglycemia affecting peripheral, autonomic, and cranial nerves

diseases.name: Tumor / Neoplasm
diseases.description: Abnormal tissue growth (benign or malignant) requiring assessment, staging, and appropriate treatment

diseases.name: Iron Deficiency Anemia
diseases.description: Reduced hemoglobin due to iron deficiency causing fatigue, weakness, and pallor
